purpose: Add the business-neutral workforce account directory, permanent username history, releasable phone history, optimistic revisions, and durable idempotent operations.
lockImpact: Creates a new schema and tables; takes no locks on populated application tables beyond validating the workforce-person foreign key definition.
dataImpact: Additive only; no existing data is rewritten or deleted.
backfill: Not required. Initial administrator accounts are created by the reviewed local bootstrap command after migration.
recovery: Leave the additive schema in place and forward-fix. Do not drop account identity history after it contains records.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed workforce-access-owned migration for later changes.
